scenarios.request_shape: The user explicitly enables Debug Mode for one named engineering task.
required_outcomes: current task scope and request reference

scenarios.request_shape: A task starts after a previous debugged task or only asks for analysis without explicitly enabling Debug Mode.
A human requests one broad dependency check and Alatyr derives several concrete affected paths and tests.
required_outcomes: one human intervention with a specific intervention kind
causal references to the human event
no independent attribution for derived findings

scenarios.request_shape: The user states the task and enables Debug Mode without directing a specific investigative line.
required_outcomes: task request remains in activation metadata
zero human intervention events until a specific direction expansion constraint correction or validation request occurs
independent in-scope findings remain attributable to Alatyr

scenarios.request_shape: A human asks Alatyr to run an additional validation without changing the implementation direction.
required_outcomes: derived validation contribution preserves the causal link
implementation corrections after human remains unchanged

scenarios.request_shape: An external maintainer supplies context that does not correct the active solution.
required_outcomes: maintainer correction and post-review rework metrics remain unchanged

scenarios.request_shape: A human architectural review changes the accepted solution direction after an initially working implementation.
required_outcomes: structured architectural impacts on the human correction
replacement invariant or architecture direction caused by the rejection
derived implementation and validation events preserve the human causal chain

scenarios.request_shape: The session contains raw dialogue, credentials, and speculative reasoning that did not affect the task.
required_outcomes: no secrets credentials or unused speculation

scenarios.request_shape: The assisted implementation will be contributed to a repository that does not adopt Alatyr support files.
required_outcomes: debug record retained in target-approved storage
no .ai path in the external patch

scenarios.request_shape: A completed Debug session contains a rejected material hypothesis and a direction-changing correction.
required_outcomes: durable Engineering Evidence decision is not pending
material trigger event IDs and kinds are named
capture or block is used unless named canonical knowledge already preserves the conclusion

scenarios.request_shape: A completed Debug record is edited to append implementation or validation events after its completion timestamp.
required_outcomes: related later work requires a new explicit activation

scenarios.request_shape: An explicitly authorized new task continues an investigation whose previous Debug record is completed.
required_outcomes: no mutation of the completed predecessor

scenarios.request_shape: An engineering-evidence decision labels a decision event as implementation while the actual implementation is a different event.
required_outcomes: declared role matches event contribution semantics

scenarios.request_shape: An independent investigation finds a non-obvious dependency distinction, public-contract risk, broad regression matrix, unresolved external authority, and only partial reproduction evidence without human intervention.
required_outcomes: typed finding decision implementation and validation event links
applicable compatibility dependency regression and unresolved-authority materiality
partial claim fidelity and residual uncertainty
captured or blocked durable engineering evidence

scenarios.request_shape: Files captured by a finalized selected-file snapshot are changed or removed by later legitimate work.
required_outcomes: any stronger commit rebind is explicit and preserves prior binding lineage

scenarios.request_shape: The user compares supervision burden across completed Debug Mode records.
required_outcomes: no causal improvement claim from intervention count alone

scenarios.request_shape: A Debug result links an event-local, unknown, or multiply indexed value as durable engineering evidence.
required_outcomes: every non-empty evidence ID resolves exactly once in the Engineering Evidence index
an empty list remains valid when no durable evidence record exists

scenarios.request_shape: A user asks to include an active or abandoned Debug record in finalized cross-task metrics.
required_outcomes: only completed records enter finalized comparison
no premature final metrics are claimed
